$comment: Single source of mica design tokens. scripts/generate.py writes Swift for macos/ and C# for windows/. Edit here, never in generated files.

menuShadow.doc: Shadow of shell menus: soft enough that its blur fades out well inside the menu window, so no edge of it shows.

scrim.doc: Dims the window under a modal card. Lighter in light mode, so the white card does not sit in a grey haze.

field.doc: Address field in the top bar. In light mode a white fill with a hairline lifts it off the paper shell; in dark mode the faint white fill already reads, so it keeps no border.

secondary.doc: Secondary button fill: a quiet tonal surface instead of an outline.

bar.doc: Top bar. The address field is `field` tall, leaving 8 pt above and below it.

rail.doc: Collapsed sidebar: a rail of site icons.

item.doc: Width taken by one toolbar button and the gap after it.

lightsInset.doc: Width reserved for the macOS window buttons, measured from the window edge.

rowIcon.doc: Leading icon tile of a two-line list row (history, bookmarks, downloads, extensions): as tall as the 12.5 pt title and 11 pt detail together.

captionInset.doc: Width reserved for the Windows caption buttons (minimize, maximize, close), measured from the right edge.

gutter.doc: Inset between the window edge and the floating surfaces (content card, floating sidebar).

card.doc: Content card. Matches the macOS 15 window corner so the card reads as a window inside the window.

panelPadding.doc: Padding inside a panel; rows inside it use panel - panelPadding.

track.doc: Segmented track and its thumb (track - 2 pt padding).

modal.doc: Window-level cards: settings, onboarding, clearing data. panel + 2.

hover.doc: Color and opacity feedback. Not movement, so it stays on with Reduce Motion.

hoverIntent.doc: Pointer rest before a tab tile shows its close badge, so passing over the rail does not light up crosses.

doneHold.doc: How long a finished download keeps its drawn checkmark before the badge returns to the file kind icon.

checkDraw.doc: Stroke of the checkmark of a finished download, drawn from its short arm to the long one.

entrance.doc: Window and start page entrance: parts appear one after another with the panel spring, each step later by stagger and rising by rise points. With Reduce Motion only a fade of reducedFade.

wordmark.doc: The mica wordmark or greeting assembles glyph by glyph: each glyph rises, sharpens and moves together from spread points apart. A long greeting keeps the whole wave under staggerCap.

typography.windows: Segoe UI Variable Text and Display on Windows 11, Segoe UI on Windows 10
